changelog.title: What's New in 8.0.0
items: SteamLite 8.0.0 Early Release — this is an early build of SteamLite 8.0.0, released for participants who chose to take part in early access
Early Access Notice — you have chosen to participate in early access for this build, so expect that some features may still be unfinished or unstable
Bug Fix Waves Coming Next Month — major bug-fix waves are planned for next month as issues are identified and reported
Bug Reports — please take any bugs or unexpected behaviour with a grain of salt while this early build is being tested
Theme Maker — create your own themes with live preview, your name as author, and a description; save them to the Community section or export the .json to publish
Theme Shop now separates Official SteamLite Themes from Community Themes (published to GitHub + themes you create)
Theme Shop refresh button to reload the catalog
Community themes from the SteamLite GitHub repository are supported again
UI Editor (SUE) removed — replaced by the Theme Maker
New achievement: Theme Author (create your first theme)
2 new free themes: Neon Noir, Glacier Mint
10 new community themes are now available in the Theme Shop (by Castiel and Alex)

news.title: SteamLite 8.0.0 Early Build Is Live!
news.content: This is an early build of SteamLite 8.0.0. You have chosen to participate in early access for this build, so please expect bugs, unfinished areas, or unexpected behaviour while testing. Take any bugs with a grain of salt for now. Bug-fix waves are coming next month as we work through issues reported during early access.

news.title: We Are Hiring!
news.content: Want to help build the future of SteamLite? We are looking to expand the team! Come down to the GitHub Discussions page to get started and find out how you can join the project.

news.title: SteamLite 8.0.0 Early Access Is Here!
news.content: SteamLite 8.0.0 is now available as an early-access build. You have chosen to participate in early access for this build, which means bugs and rough edges are to be expected. Please take any bugs with a grain of salt while the build is being tested. Bug-fix waves are coming next month, with fixes and improvements based on issues found during early access.
